_comment: Reception knowledge for ONE tenant. Copy to knowledge.json beside .env on the server.
It is never committed and never uploaded: every rsync step excludes it, exactly like .env.
Every value here is a PLACEHOLDER. Replace them. Do not deploy invented business details —
an unconfigured receptionist says it does not know, which is correct; a confidently wrong one is not.
Lobby owns this file. Appointments, Calendar, Connect and Pay own their own records and are
asked over their APIs at the moment they are needed. Do not copy their data in here.

business.name: REPLACE — the business name reception should use
business.description: REPLACE — one or two sentences a receptionist would say about what this business does

locations.label: REPLACE — e.g. Head office
locations.address: REPLACE — full address as reception would read it out
locations.notes: REPLACE — parking, entrance, accessibility, or leave empty

services.name: REPLACE — service name
services.description: REPLACE — what it is, in a sentence
services.fee: REPLACE ONLY IF APPROVED — leave empty and reception will say it cannot quote a fee

contact.email: REPLACE — the address reception may give out
contact.phone: REPLACE — the number reception may give out
contact.routing: REPLACE — who to pass what to, e.g. 'billing questions go to accounts'

faqs.question: REPLACE — a question reception is actually asked
faqs.answer: REPLACE — the approved answer, in full

handover.instructions: REPLACE — what reception should say when passing a visitor to a person
